snippet.title: Terraria 1.4.5 Bigger & Boulder Official Trailer
snippet.description: Terraria 1.4.5 is launching on January 27th, Bigger and Boulder than ever before!  Check out some of the new changes and content in the brand new trailer... and stay tuned for the full launch posts and changelog on launch day!
